## 📦 Install · Kurulum

**Easiest / En kolay** — paste in Terminal · Terminal'e yapıştır:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ozkurtomer/sysmon/main/scripts/install.sh | bash
```

**Or / Ya da** — download `SysMon.dmg`, drag to Applications. If macOS says *"could not verify … free of malware"*: **Done** → System Settings → **Privacy & Security** → **Open Anyway** (macOS 15+) · *"doğrulayamadı"* derse: **Bitti** → Sistem Ayarları → **Gizlilik ve Güvenlik** → **Yine de Aç**.

Requires macOS 13+ · Apple Silicon & Intel · ⭐ Star the repo if you like it! · Beğendiysen yıldız ver!
